name: tangent-blend-retainer
why: The tangent pinch at the size it was found on, the retainer stock: one half-circle spine whose both ends land on tangencies, one on the disc's own seam. Before the vendored patch this was the shape that proved the validity gate's worth — 22 open edges, in bounds, IsDone() == true, caught only by BRepCheck_Analyzer. It now holds the measured result of the single-stripe pinch treatment, tangent-generator edge and all.
